headlines.text: Looking back to 2024, when Samoa Joe vs. Dustin Rhodes met in an Eliminator Match, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 6.46.
2024 brought us this moment: Adam Copeland vs. Penta El Zero M put the AEW TNT Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.84. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
It was 2024 when it was a long-awaited, welcome sight as Anthony Ogogo returned to the ring after just under 3 years away, appearing on Dynamite.
